Near the equator and in some parts of eastern Africa, the contour values are relatively low, mostly 15%—20%; in the southern and southwestern areas, the contour values are relatively high, with 25% and 30% appearing, and locally reaching 40%; near Madagascar there is also a low-value area of about 15%. Near the equator and in some parts of eastern Africa, the contour values are relatively low, mostly 15%—20%; in the southern and southwestern areas, the contour values are relatively high, with 25% and 30% appearing, and locally reaching 40%; near Madagascar there is also a low-value area of about 15%. Then reason: Combining the climate distribution, precipitation is relatively abundant near the equator and in humid coastal areas, while precipitation is relatively low in the relatively arid areas of southern and southwestern Africa. Comparing the relative variability values in the diagram shows that areas with more precipitation have smaller annual relative variability of precipitation, and areas with less precipitation have larger annual relative variability of precipitation; the two are generally negatively correlated.
